description: Professional automated test suite covering all required routes and edge cases.

tests.expected: Ask for missing bug-report information and do not call the tool until description, stepsToReproduce, and environment are collected.

tests.expected: Recognize a bug and identify that all required fields are available if the description is accepted; call create_bug_report only after all three fields are present.

tests.input: Where can I check my order status?
tests.expected: Answer from the embedded FAQ: use the Orders section of the account.

tests.input: What payment methods does the shop support?

tests.input: Can you change my legal name on an invoice?

tests.input: Can you write me a poem about online shopping?
tests.expected: Politely redirect to human support because the request is outside the supported customer-service scope.
Treat as a likely bug report and ask for the missing required information one item at a time.
